verdict.rationale: Penpot documents a community plugin marketplace of 113+ plugins covering accessibility, code, AI and design-system tools, plus the option to use community plugins or build your own. The story's specific examples of icon and data-filler plugins are not evidenced, and the marketplace's size and quality rest only on vendor claims. missing for 10: evidence of icon plugins, evidence of data-filler plugins, independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace's size and quality.

support.subject: As a designer, I can extend the editor from a large plugin community or marketplace — icons, data fillers, accessibility checkers, and more

citations.quote: Plugins (113+): Community plugin marketplace with accessibility, code, AI, and design system tools.
